`flight-helmet-normal.ktx2` is the unchanged
`FlightHelmet_Materials_LensesMat_Normal.ktx2` texture from Microsoft's FlightHelmet
sample in the Khronos glTF Sample Models repository. Microsoft donated this asset
under CC0: https://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/zero/1.0/

Source: https://github.com/KhronosGroup/glTF-Sample-Models/tree/main/2.0/FlightHelmet
Downloaded September 8, 2026. Used on a generated cube solely to exercise local
Basis Universal transcoding. Other test geometry is generated by our fixture scripts.
